newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka 1996 broad money grows by 10.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka 1996 broad money grows by 10.8 pct.

text.p: Sri Lanka's broad money (M2) growth fell to 10.8 percent on a point-to-point basis at the end of last year from 19.2 percent at the end of 1995, the Central Bank said in its annual report released on Wednesday.

Money supply decelerated considerably owning to a slowing down of economic activity and greater caution by banks in lending, particularly during and after the drought and power cuts, said the report, a copy of which was obtained by Reuters.
Banks also faced liquidity constraints because of a rise in non-performing loans and the continuation of tight monetary policy, it said.
